question.text: For a Cat III AIF, 'tax impact' on performance primarily arises from:

answer.text: Both AIF-level (for business income/F&O) and investor-level (for capital gains, dividends)

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Section 9.3 and 9.7, taxation happens at multiple layers: fund level (business/F&O) AND investor level (capital gains, dividend, interest). The Trap: Single-layer or zero-impact views are incorrect. Cross-Exam Context: Critical for pre-tax vs post-tax return communication. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Always compute post-tax IRR for comparisons — gross IRR alone misleads.
